name: IKSU Sport (klätterhallen Lofoten)

coord_source.ref: https://www.iksu.se/en/our-facilities/iksu-sport/ (Google Maps place link for IKSU sport on the facility page)

research_notes: Track C: located from the Google Maps place link for IKSU sport on the facility page of iksu.se. The climbing hall Lofoten (rope walls plus bouldering, opened 2018) is inside the IKSU sport building; the pages I read do not name the hall, which is only known from the earlier pass (news release) - a reviewer should confirm the hall name. IKSU is a student-origin non-profit sports centre (category university is a judgement call; it could also be read as a fitness-type centre). A search-engine result for the IKSU site reported public day-entry prices for the hall, but I did not read that page directly, so public access is not claimed in the evidence.

name: Varbergs Klätterklubb

coord_source.ref: https://www.varbergsklatterklubb.se/find/ (Google Maps place link maps.app.goo.gl/XHqPGJK87u66NDbq8, place Varbergs Klätterklubb)

research_notes: Track C: located from the place link on the Directions page (short link resolved to a Google Maps place named after the club). Hall is stated to be open to everyone with a single-visit price (110 kr adult), hours Mon/Wed/Thu evenings and Saturday afternoon; about 250 m2 of bouldering plus a top-rope wall. Pages were read through a page-text fetch, not the raw source.

name: Helsingborgs Klätterklubb (Klätterladan)

coord_source.ref: https://helsingborgsk2.se/om-oss/lokalen/ (Find-us link maps.app.goo.gl/52mu5VfrkLMeYihM8, resolves to a Google Maps place named Helsingborgs Klätterklubb)

research_notes: Track C: located from the Find-us short link on the hall page, resolved to a Google Maps place with the club name. The page names the hall as the barn at the Dalhem recreation centre and gives no street address. Open to everyone on Tuesday and Thursday evenings, closed in summer and holidays; several boulder sections plus MoonBoard and leadable high walls. Page read through a page-text fetch.

name: Kalmar Klätterklubb
research_notes: Track C: located from the marker coordinates of the map on the training-venue page. Hall is in the Spelefanten sports hall; boulder wall open to everyone (non-member price 80 kr), rope wall needs a proficiency card; weekly opening hours shown for the current week.

name: Visby Klätterklubb

coord_source.ref: https://visbyklatterklubb.squarespace.com/om-oss (map block for address 5A Holmen, Visby; mapLat/mapLng)

research_notes: Track C: located from the map block (address 5A Holmen) on the About page. The domain visbyklatterklubb.se redirects to the Squarespace host, which is where all pages were read (the earlier pass could not load /om-oss on the .se domain). Single-visit fee exists for non-members (120 SEK adult); rope wall needs a green or red card. Silo hall, bouldering and rope climbing.

name: Höglandsklättrarna Eksjö

coord_source.ref: https://hoglandsklattrarnaeksjo.se/ (link goo.gl/maps/qzDBtfc9an7gVT9c6 resolves to a Google Maps place Spelverket)

research_notes: Track C: located from the place link on the home page (Spelverket). Public try-on sessions on Tuesday evenings (100 kr, anyone welcome), small hall with a 10 m rope wall and a similar-sized boulder area. Status kept as unknown: the page text says the season starts on 2 September (a Tuesday only in 2025) and the fee table is headed 2025, so the page may not be updated for 2026.

name: Mora Klätterklubb
